domain: A7 stability and A8 build/supply-chain integrity (committed tree at 53b6df82; live site and GitHub settings read via curl/gh)

risks.title: LAN match freezes for the remaining player when the other PC drops or stalls
risks.player_impact: If the other PC closes, crashes or loses Wi-Fi, the remaining player's match stops within about 20 ticks and stays frozen; the only notice is the window title, which is not visible in fullscreen.
risks.evidence: canAdvance() refuses once the session is maxAhead=20 ticks past the confirmed frontier, after which NetHost only calls session.advance(0); on EVENT_DISCONNECT the only reaction is the title 'The other PC has gone'. The AI takeover dropSlot() exists but git grep finds no caller except net/tools/rollback_check.gd (a test).
risks.needs_outside_expert: No; pulling the network cable in a private LAN playtest would confirm it.

risks.title: Public repo has secret scanning and push protection switched off
risks.player_impact: No harm today (no secrets found), but many automated sessions commit straight to an unprotected public main, so a leaked key would go public with no safety net.
where: GitHub API branches/main/protection (404 Branch not protected)
GitHub API actions/permissions (allowed_actions all, sha_pinning_required false)
risks.evidence: gh api shows secret_scanning, secret_scanning_push_protection and dependabot_security_updates all 'disabled', main not protected, and any action allowed (every workflow pins SHAs anyway). HEAD and history scans found no live secrets.

risks.title: Saved prefs and remap files are parse-safe but not type-checked
risks.player_impact: A truncated file falls back to defaults, but a hand-edited file with a wrong value type (say a string where a bool is saved) can stop the menu set-up or remap load part way until the file is deleted.
risks.evidence: load_all() returns {} for missing or non-dictionary JSON and load_file() needs schema 1, but values then go to bool() and set_option() unchecked; apply_file() indexes d[key][id].get(...) without type checks and runs before load_and_apply() sets SimAct's statics. What the script error does in a release build was not run.

risks.title: LAN session trusts the peer's packets and keeps every input for the whole match
risks.player_impact: A misbehaving machine on the same /24 that passes the handshake could add inputs at arbitrary ticks (memory growth) or send wrong-typed dictionaries (script errors); even honest play keeps about 36,000 input entries per 5-minute 1v1.
risks.evidence: Kind-2 packets decode to any Variant dictionary (objects refused) and NetHost._take reads 'ai', 'words', 'inputs' and 'chk' untyped; addInput stores any tick; _confirm prunes used/usedW/outLog but never inputs/words; resimFrames grows every frame. Mitigations: one peer, /24 filter, length-checked binary game packets.

risks.title: Prefs file is reopened and JSON-parsed every frame
risks.player_impact: After 45 s of a match the HUD can read and parse user://ui_prefs.json one to three times a frame; a small steady CPU cost, not a crash.
risks.evidence: _update_teach() calls UiPrefs.get_bool('taught_beam') each frame once t_now >= 45 when the beam_teach feature is on (feature state not checked); get_bool calls load_all(), which opens and parses the file on every call with no in-memory cache.

risks.title: Two presentation logs grow without a cap
risks.player_impact: Negligible memory growth: the camera's panel log grows across every match of a session and the barks log within a match; it only matters for a demo left running for many hours.
risks.evidence: panel_log.append has no trim and is not in split_rig's reset block (lines 460-467); the rig is made once in main.gd. The barks log is rate-limited, rebuilt per match (main.gd:366) and off by default.

risks.title: Next web build polls gamepads every 80 ms while audio is not running
risks.player_impact: On a page nobody has touched (audio still suspended, e.g. the AI demo), a timer calls navigator.getGamepads 12 times a second indefinitely; a small CPU cost that browsers throttle in hidden tabs.
risks.evidence: padWatch starts setInterval(padTick, 80) while any context is not 'running' and clears it only when all are; build-site injects the snippet into /play/ and /bench/. The live /play/ page has no such timer (CI has not deployed since 72a4d1e4).

risks.title: Web preset ships the LAN code that the desktop presets leave out
risks.player_impact: No harm today, since nothing calls the net classes, but the next web build would carry the LAN/ENet scripts as dead code that the desktop presets exclude.
risks.evidence: The Web exclude_filter lacks net/* while the Windows, Linux and macOS filters list it; outside net/, Net* class names appear only in comments. The live build's pin 257a766c has no net/ folder, so it carries none.

risks.title: Live web engine is a hand-published custom build pinned only by the owner's own hash
risks.player_impact: Every visitor runs a patched Godot wasm built by a project workflow and uploaded by hand; the chain is traceable and hash-pinned, but nothing outside the owner's account attests it, and the build trusts emsdk and PyPI downloads without hash checks.
risks.evidence: The live /play/index.wasm (38,450,604 bytes) matches the pinned wasmSha512 in full; release web-template-4.7.2-lazy-1 targets a08b8fa9, run 40624057612 (workflow_dispatch on a08b8fa9, success) exists, and the owner account uploaded the assets. emsdk install and pip install scons==4.10.1 are not hash-verified, and this checkout keeps its (read-only) token.

risks.title: Windows account name, local paths and a home LAN address are in the public repo
risks.player_impact: No player harm: the owner's Windows account name appears in full local paths on 64 lines, and a home-network address (10.0.0.135) appears in a comment and in test-kit files, all outside the shipped builds.
risks.evidence: git grep -I on HEAD finds 64 lines matching C:\Users\<account> under docs/ (animation, ep, perf, rendering, tools, vfx, world), research/engine-spike, tools/flash, tools/machine and sim/core/tools. Commit author e-mails are GitHub noreply; the other e-mail strings are placeholders or third-party.

risks.title: HUD mock sheets taken out of the tree are still in public history
risks.player_impact: No player harm: the 16 PNGs and 2 HTML mock pages removed in 83cda4a1 to be 'kept local' can still be downloaded from the public repo's history.
risks.evidence: git show --stat 83cda4a1 lists the deletions, and the files are in the earlier commits b4d0b693, cf36d6cb and 73f14ccd. homework/, .private/ and tools/capture/raw/ were never committed.

risks.title: Desktop game keeps running at full rate when it loses focus
risks.player_impact: Alt-tabbing out of a desktop match only releases held inputs: the match plays on and the CPU and GPU stay busy (vsync-capped) while the window is in the background.
risks.evidence: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT calls host.release_all() only; shipped code sets no low-processor mode or frame cap.

risks.title: Desktop builds are unsigned
risks.player_impact: Anyone given a desktop build gets the operating system's unknown-publisher warnings and has no signature to check that the binary came from the project.
risks.evidence: Windows codesign/enable=false, and macOS has codesign=1 with an empty identity; desktop-builds.yml uploads the exports as plain workflow artifacts.
risks.needs_outside_expert: Possibly, for each store's current signing and notarisation requirements (not verified here).

checked_ok.why: Every uses: is a full 40-hex SHA with its version in a comment; all are first-party actions/* (checkout, setup-node, upload-artifact, upload-pages-artifact, deploy-pages) plus the local ./.github/actions/setup-godot; there are no third-party actions.

checked_ok.where: .github/workflows/ci.yml:20-21, ci.yml:532-535; gh secret list; gh api actions/permissions/workflow
checked_ok.why: Every workflow sets contents: read, and only the deploy job gets pages: write and id-token: write. There are no secrets or variables, the default token is read-only, there is no pull_request_target, inputs go through env (no expression injection), and most checkouts set persist-credentials: false.

checked_ok.area: Godot editor and templates in CI
checked_ok.why: Downloads come over HTTPS from the official GitHub release and are SHA-512 checked against pinned values before use. The pin is a hash, not a signature.
fetchTemplate checks the size, the zip SHA-512 and the wasm SHA-512, and deletes the file on a mismatch. The patch's SHA-256 matches the release asset digest and the HEAD blob.

The only npm dependency is the optional dev screenshot package @napi-rs/canvas. build-site uses node: builtins and repo files only, and the live /play/ loads only same-origin index.js, with no CDN scripts.
There are no .exe, .dll, .so, .wasm, .pck, .zip or .gdextension files and no addons/.

No AWS, GitHub, OpenAI-style, Slack, Google or private-key patterns turned up, and no password= or .env/key files. The history hits in 014c56a8 and d9d30e3b are false positives ('mask-diff', 'desk-gl' strings).
homework/, .private/ and tools/capture/raw/ are ignored and were never committed.
Craters 400, slides 200 and store 16384 records are capped, the store's static index clears past 16 states, and water windows and aftermath jobs are removed when they finish.

checked_ok.where: render/core/sim_host.gd:464; ui/core/ui_event_hub.gd:660; render/vfx/vfx_hub.gd:719; ui/core/ui_data.gd:213; sim/world/planet.gd:361; render/core/planet_view.gd:1845; render/vfx/shots.gd:247; render/core/main.gd _record
checked_ok.why: The feeds, holes, text memo, planet memo (7), blow-out set (256), shot table (160) and frame ring (240) are all trimmed; render effects use node pools (beam_view.gd:154).
The accumulator adds at most 0.1 s a frame (6 ticks), so a tab coming back from hidden does not spiral, and planet loading is time-sliced per frame.

checked_ok.where: while-true sites in net/enet_transport.gd:101, sim/world/*.gd, sim/core/planet_load.gd:127
checked_ok.why: Each loop has a terminating condition (data-driven or event-drained). Shipped scripts have no threads and no per-tick print/push_error.
Entries are keyed and SHA-256 checked, witness-verified and written atomically natively; a bad read is a miss, and eviction keeps 24 files.

checked_ok.area: URL options on the public page
checked_ok.why: Only allow-listed URL_ARGS are read, and gate-bypassing ones are dropped off localhost.
The SHA-512 of the live wasm equals tools/web-template.json wasmSha512 in full.
Only a coarse OS and browser name derived from the user agent goes in, and sending is player-initiated.

limits: Godot and the game were not run; GDScript runtime effects (bool() on a String, script errors in release builds) are inferred from code.
422 shipped scripts and about 328 static containers were sampled with heuristic greps, not read end to end.
ENet's default peer timeout is not set in code and its value was not verified.
Whether emsdk verifies its own toolchain downloads was not verified.
The history secret search covered only the listed patterns, and hidden-tab CPU behaviour (browser throttling of requestAnimationFrame) was not measured.
docs/net, docs/legal and the other excluded folders were not read, per the independence rule.
